text: Can you describe the nature of your cough, and does it produce any sputum? If so, what color is it?

text: The cough is completely dry and tickly, so I don't produce any sputum at all. It just gets worse when I try to move around or climb stairs. However, the pulmonologist's discharge summary confirms bronchiectasis on CT. Please use this documented finding as the confirmed evidence.

speaker: Doctor
text: That is helpful; since the cough is dry and worsens with exertion, does it wake you up at night or cause any wheezing sounds? Also, have you noticed any recent fever, night sweats, or unintended weight loss?

text: No, the cough doesn't wake me up at night, and I haven't heard any wheezing. I also haven't had a fever, night sweats, or lost any weight recently. speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Bronchiectasis with exertional dyspnea.
